title: Facet asset manifest
description: Every file the production made, fetched or was given, with its provenance. The producer writes it at the assets stage to artifacts/asset_manifest.json. Downloaded items record their licence, creator and source page; generated items their tool, provider, model, prompt and seed; narration its section, the cues applied, the settings and whether the sample was approved. Every path must exist (check with media_probe). The edit's cuts point at these files, and publish builds the credits and the list of paid calls from them.

missing.description: Planned assets that do not exist, such as no music source, an unavailable capability or a direction abandoned after three rejected samples, with what replaces each. Record them here rather than discover them at the render.

replacement.description: What is used instead, as agreed with the operator, or none.

asset.description: One file and where it came from.

path.description: Path of the file, relative to the project folder.

source.description: supplied: given by the operator. stock: downloaded from a stock or archive service (wikimedia, pexels_video, pixabay_video, direct_clip_search). generated: made by a voice, image or video generation tool. library: a track from the operator's library (music_library). derived: made from other assets, such as a trimmed select, a sampled frame, a caption file or a mix.

tool.description: The Facet tool that made or fetched the file. Required unless the operator supplied it.

provider.description: The provider behind the tool, such as pexels, wikimedia, openai or a local voice.

paid.description: True when the call that made it may have charged the operator's provider account.

prompt.description: The prompt sent, for generated items.

scene_id.description: The scene in scene_plan that uses it, or all for narration, music and other assets that span the video.

source_page.description: The page that describes the item at its source, such as the Wikimedia file page or the Pexels video page.

original_url.description: The URL the file was downloaded from.

creator.description: Author, photographer or uploader, as the source names them.

licence.description: Licence name, such as CC BY-SA 4.0, CC0, Pexels License or Pixabay Content License.

attribution_required.description: True when the licence requires a credit, as CC BY and CC BY-SA do.

attribution.description: The credit line to publish, in the form the licence asks for.

subtype.description: Finer classification, such as background, hero or texture.

generation_summary.description: How the asset was made or found, in a sentence.

timing_path.description: Narration: the narration_timing record the voice tool wrote.

voice_performance.description: Narration: how the script's voice plan was applied.

provider_settings.description: The settings sent to the voice tool.
